# Entercation Info Inc. / Outerprise

> Detached evidence delivery at institutional boundaries. All listed drafts are Individual Internet-Draft (Work in Progress). All test vectors are synthetic.

- [Public app](https://entercation.lovable.app)
- [Vince Jones ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0008-6712-8136)
- [GitHub specification](https://github.com/entercation2021-hue/outerprise-spec)
- [GitHub project index](https://github.com/entercation2021-hue/Entercation-AI-Frameworks)
